ICML — Integrated Consumer Goods Manufacturing and Logistics facilities that combine production and distribution.
Choupal Saagar — Rural hypermarkets that serve as procurement hubs and retail outlets for farmers.
Agri-Sourcing — The procurement of agricultural raw materials like wheat, soya, and leaf tobacco directly from the farm gate.
